$comment: Rost's own light values, read by bin/build-tokens.mjs on top of Figma's light mode. Each rule names tokens (* is one level of the path, ** any number), optionally only those whose Figma light value is `from`, and the light value they take instead: a primitive (@color/light/...) or a hex. Later rules win. Only theme colour tokens, and only their light value. Checked with node bin/contrast.mjs.

rules.why: Figma's light mode keeps the bright green for icons and text. #00d669 is 1.9:1 on #fcfcfc. The darker green of the same family is 6.2:1.
Hover goes dimmer in dark and darker in light. Figma had it go lighter, to #00f882, which nearly disappears.
A focus ring has to be seen: 3:1 at least. The pale greens were 1.4 and 2.7.
The underline of the selected tab and the line under a hovered project: one step darker than the fill green, 4:1.
Its hover, one step darker again.
On the green fill. Figma's #454545 is 3.5:1 there; #171717 is 9:1.
The pressed green is darker, so these go to the same near-black as the label.
Secondary buttons and tags darken as you press. Figma's light mode had hover and pressed both on mid-greys, and a tag's label on its pressed grey at 3.9:1.
Pressed, one step further. #171717 on #999999 is 6.3:1.
Error text. #e93120 is 4.2:1 on #fcfcfc, just short. #ae1b13 is 6.9:1.
Hover darker, as with the green.
The positive green as a mark or text on a light ground: #31d84d is 1.8:1, #0e7118 is 6.4:1.
Orange can't be text on white and stay orange. #fda50d is 1.9:1; #7a4805 is 7.4:1, a dark amber.
